bio.text: Samantha Kattan is a candidate for New York State Assembly District 37, which the Queens Ledger says stretches from Long Island City through Sunnyside, Ridgewood and parts of Maspeth; the seat is held by Assemblymember Claire Valdez, according to a February 2026 profile.

The Ledger reports she grew up in Austin, Texas, studied urban planning at the University of Texas at Austin, and moved to Brooklyn in 2014, where she helped co-found tenant associations and a Brownsville and East New York coalition called HOPE.
She works for the Urban Homesteading Assistance Board, where she previously directed organizing and now handles contracts and administration, and lives in Ridgewood.

sources.title: New Mom, Veteran Organizer: Kattan Seeks Queens Assembly Seat
